## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Soṇapaṇḍitacariya* ("The Conduct of the Scholar Soṇa", Cp 25) is a verse text preserved in the *Cariyāpiṭaka* section of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. The work is included among the canonical narratives illustrating the Bodhisatta's practice of the perfections, cataloged in comparative studies of the *Cariyāpiṭaka* and the Jātakas by André Bareau [Bareau]. Modern translations of the text include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels are recorded in SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis shows Pali-internal reuse with the commentary, the *Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā*, across four shared passages (totalling 589 characters, with the longest alignment covering segments 2.1–6.4) [DharmaNexus].

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0512a) (§2.1–6.4 ↔ §1448–1461)
